# Boston Political Review

> A nonpartisan student journalism publication from Boston University covering politics, policy, and current events with rigorous analysis and commentary.

The Boston Political Review (BPR) is Boston University's premier undergraduate political news and commentary platform. The publication delivers nonpartisan coverage of U.S. politics, policy issues, and institutional analysis with a focus on accessibility and journalistic integrity.

## Key Topics

- Boston University
- Student Journalism
- Nonpartisan News
- U.S. Politics
- Trump Administration
- TikTok Policy
- Tariffs
- SNAP Benefits
- DEI Programs
- Media Censorship
- Political Commentary
- Massachusetts Politics
- China Policy
- Editorial Mission
- Publication Overview
